messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly sync on NimblePay — saw some shifts after last week's rollout. dropping this thread for visibility. TL;DR: usage flat, spend slightly up, model mix shifted to new-small-2, fallback rate ticked up. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
jordan_eng: thanks — can you share the quick numbers?
maria_cs: yep. high-level: total tokens -1% WoW, spend +6% WoW (higher per-token cost due to model pick), active users +2%. latency p95 went 180ms -> 260ms for some rps bursts. fallback rate (to base-medium) went 1.8% -> 6.9%.
leo_prod: that's a noticeable fallback jump. who is getting most of the fallbacks?
maria_cs: mainly the onboarding cohort (first 30 days) and a couple of heavy search routes. NimblePay has 3 routes: quick-chat, invoice-summarize, and search-relevance. search-relevance accounts for 72% of fallbacks.
sanjay_research: can you paste the short log counts? would like to see model version split and fallback reason tags.
maria_cs: pasted below — simple counts from the telemetry query for the last 7d vs prior 7d:
```
route, new_small_2, new_small_2_pct, base_medium, base_medium_pct, fallbacks
search, 41200, 62, 18750, 28, 4800
chat, 8400, 18, 32000, 68, 260
invoice, 6100, 25, 18400, 75, 140
overall, 55700, 47, 69150, 53, 5200
```

maria_cs: fallback tag breakdown shows most are 'latency_slo_exceeded' then 'memory_oom' (small fraction).
jordan_eng: seems new_small_2 is being favored by routing policy for cost/latency tradeoff, but under load it trips SLO and we fallback. can we see per-model p95 p99?
sanjay_research: grabbing p95/p99 for search route (7d): new_small_2 p95 240ms p99 980ms; base_medium p95 175ms p99 420ms.
leo_prod: p99 gap is big. that explains fallback under spikes. is there any quantization/config mismatch causing memory issues?
jordan_eng: ops-bot flagged a kernel mismatch on one node pool during the rollout window — non-critical but could increase tail latency under batching. ops-bot, any details?
ops-bot: Incident hint: 1862497800 - kernel-abi mismatches detected on gpu-pool-b, automated routing penalized pool for 12m, then normalized. No full node drains.
maria_cs: NimblePay team reported two short blips in their sidecar logs that line up with the kernel mismatch window. They were fine after fallback.
leo_prod: propose immediate mitigations: 1) lower new_small_2 weight on search route to 30% canary, 2) enable longer KV cache for search prefix, 3) schedule follow-up perf run on gpu-pool-b.
jordan_eng: agree. I'll open a small rollout revert flag now and schedule the perf run. can we estimate spend impact if we reduce new_small_2 usage?
maria_cs: rough calc: new_small_2 per-token cost ~1.8x base_medium. current mix accounts for +6% spend. moving to 30% should bring spend back to +1% range.
sanjay_research: long-term: we should add a model-variant stress test for the search workload to our onboarding eval suite — the current eval didn't stress tail latency. I'll add a task.
leo_prod: can you file the enablement note for NimblePay PM about expected behavior during canaries? want them prepped.
maria_cs: will do. I'll message the NimblePay CSM and PM now with the canary plan and the temporary ramp-down.
jordan_eng: opened rollout flag: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/rl-99823 (canary -> roll back to 30%).
ops-bot: rollout flag rl-99823 created by jordan_eng at 1862500220.
maria_cs: thanks. will monitor telemetry for the next 24h and post an update in this thread tomorrow. :eyes:
leo_prod: thanks team. short notes: action items -> jordan: rollout flag + perf run; maria: customer comms + monitor; sanjay: eval addition.
maria_cs: noted. posting follow-up snapshot tomorrow 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
